question: What happens to those who do or do not become absorbed in nada?
premises: Inner absorption in sameness with that sound is perceived suddenly.
Some do not attain absorption into that state.
Those who do not attain it remain immersed in body and related limitations.
inference: Sudden identification with nada lifts awareness, while failure to identify leaves one sunk in bodily consciousness.
uncertainties: The bracketed reading antarma[ttama] is uncertain in the supplied text.
plain_english: Absorption into that same sound is perceived suddenly. Those who do not become absorbed in it remain sunk in the body and similar limitations.
